decision.summary: The Federal Reserve decided to keep the target range for the federal funds rate at 5-1/4 to 5-1/2 percent.

changes.quote: In recent months, there has been a lack of further progress toward the Committee's 2 percent inflation objective.
changes.explanation: The Fed added this line to highlight that inflation progress has stalled recently.

changes.quote: Beginning in June, the Committee will slow the pace of decline of its securities holdings by reducing the monthly redemption cap on Treasury securities from $60 billion to $25 billion.
changes.explanation: The Fed plans to reduce the amount of bonds it lets roll off its balance sheet each month, easing monetary contraction in that area.

tone_quotes.quote: In recent months, there has been a lack of further progress toward the Committee's 2 percent inflation objective.
The Committee does not expect it will be appropriate to reduce the target range until it has gained greater confidence that inflation is moving sustainably toward 2 percent.

for_you.text: Card rates should not move on this decision; a $5,000 balance at about 21.47% APR costs about $89.46 a month in interest.

Mortgages track the 10-year Treasury yield, not the fed funds rate. The 10-year was 4.63% and moved -6 bp on the day; if that move passed through, the payment on a new $300,000 30-year loan at 7.1% would fall by about $12.12 a month.
Savings yields should stay roughly where they are, since the Fed held rates.
Unemployment was 3.9%, and employers added an average of 203k jobs a month over the prior 3 months.

for_country.text: CPI inflation was 3.5% over the past year (March 2024); core PCE inflation, the Fed's preferred gauge, was 3.1%, against a 2% goal.
Real GDP grew at a 1.4% annualized pace in the latest reported quarter.
The 2-year Treasury yield, the most Fed-sensitive market rate, moved -8 bp on the day, and the S&P 500 moved -0.34%.
The broad trade-weighted dollar moved 0.03% on the day.

whats_next: The statement signals that the Fed will wait for clearer evidence of falling inflation before considering any rate cuts.

citations.detail: In support of its goals, the Committee decided to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 5-1/4 to 5-1/2 percent.
